Metastasi ossee litiche multiple del rac: Multiple lytic bone metastases of the spine from renal carcinoma (Spine-Mets-CT-SEG 15001)
Uomo di 70 anni con carcinoma renale. TC: 70-year-old man with renal carcinoma. Non-contrast CT from neck to pelvis (thin slices, reconstructed here at 3 mm) to plan radiotherapy of vertebral metastases. Low back pain.
Leggi il rachide con la finestra per l'o: Read the spine with the bone window and the sagittal reconstructions: which vertebrae are affected and with what appearance?
Le metastasi ossee del carcinoma renale:
Bone metastases from renal carcinoma are almost always lytic, often expansile, hypervascular (they bleed at biopsy or surgery; sometimes they are embolized before surgery) and may have a soft-tissue component. They respond poorly to conventional radiotherapy: stereotactic radiotherapy or surgery is preferred for solitary lesions.
In the report: levels involved (counted from C2 or from the sacrum), part of the vertebra, cortex, collapses, extension into the canal and foramina, stability (SINS: location, pain, type of lesion lytic or blastic, alignment, collapse, involvement of posterior elements). On non-contrast CT, lytic lesions are best seen with the bone window (about 400/1800) and on sagittal images.
Metastasi litiche ed espansive: pensa a: Lytic, expansile metastases: think of kidney, thyroid, myeloma; read the spine in the bone window and in sagittal.
Dati della collezione Spine-Mets-CT-SEG:: Data from the Spine-Mets-CT-SEG collection: renal primary; lytic lesions in T4, T6, T10, T12, L3, L4, L5.
Metastasi note (TC per radioterapia), se: Known metastases (CT for radiotherapy), without signs of cord compression: the report is enough.
Ampia lesione litica del corpo di L4, co: Large lytic lesion of the body of L4, with thinning and breach of the cortex
Si vede bene nelle assiali (circa immagi: Clearly seen on the axial images (about image 69) and on sagittal images with the bone window.
Altre lesioni litiche in L3, L5 e nei co: Other lytic lesions in L3, L5 and in the bodies of T4, T6, T10 and T12
Elenco della tabella della collezione: l: List from the collection table: lysis in T4, T6, T10, T12, L3, L4, L5. Small lesions of the thoracic spine are sought on the sagittal images.
Lesioni puramente litiche, senza compone: Purely lytic lesions, without a sclerotic component: typical of metastases from renal carcinoma
Il carcinoma renale dà metastasi litiche: Renal carcinoma gives lytic metastases, often expansile and hypervascular; blastic ones are typical of prostate and breast.
Nella spondilodiscite sono colpiti i pia: In spondylodiscitis the facing endplates and the disc are affected; here the vertebral body is replaced without disc involvement.
Metastasi ossee litiche multiple del rac: Multiple lytic bone metastases of the spine from renal carcinoma; the largest replaces the body of L4 with cortical breach: assess stability (SINS) and risk of fracture or nerve compression; indication for radiotherapy (often stereotactic, renal carcinoma is poorly radiosensitive at conventional doses)
Mieloma multiplo: elettroforesi e biopsi: Multiple myeloma: electrophoresis and bone marrow biopsy
Con un carcinoma renale noto, lesioni li: With a known renal carcinoma, lytic vertebral lesions are first of all metastases; myeloma is in the differential diagnosis only without a known tumor.
Gli emangiomi hanno trabecole verticali: Hemangiomas have thickened vertical trabeculae ("polka-dot" on axial, "corduroy" on sagittal) and do not destroy the cortex.
Mieloma multiplo con lesioni litiche a s: Multiple myeloma with punched-out lytic spinal lesions: protein electrophoresis, light chains and bone marrow biopsy, no radiotherapy for now
Reperto degenerativo della colonna lomba: Degenerative lumbar spine (disc disease, facet arthrosis, osteophytes): no focal lesion, no action beyond pain management
Emangiomi vertebrali multipli con trabec: Multiple vertebral haemangiomas with thickened vertical trabeculae («corduroy» pattern): benign lesions, no radiotherapy or further work-up
Reperto degenerativo della colonna lomba: Degenerative lumbar spine (disc disease, facet arthrosis, osteophytes, Schmorl nodes, L4 haemangioma with thickened trabeculae): no suspicious focal lesion despite the known renal carcinoma, no action beyond pain management and physiotherapy
